PRIMARY.NAME: RELATIVE_CORE_ORGANIZER_SCALE_EQUIVALENCE
PRIMARY.estimand: beta_CY : the slope of log d_CY on log L, where d_CY(L) is the arm-level median of |C - Y| divided by the operator's exact finite-size prediction at that L
PRIMARY.method: TOST in confidence-interval form: the whole two-sided (1 - 2 alpha) interval for beta_CY must lie strictly inside +- margin
PRIMARY.ACHIEVED_BOUND_MEANING: the smallest margin at which this data set would have declared equivalence

POPULATION_SUPPORT.rule: at every domain size, the number of ANALYSABLE arms must be at least ceil(5 n / 6) of the n arms run

EXTINCTION_SENSITIVITY.RULE: an extinction is a SCIENTIFIC OUTCOME. It consumes its seed, it is never replaced, and it is never deleted as a missing observation. The primary analysis is conditional on the analysable arms; this sensitivity shows what the same test gives when the extinct arms are forced to the least favourable observed value.

CONSOLIDATED_START_REGISTER.note: each arm ran in its own process, so each opened exactly one start in its own ledger; the entries are consolidated here into a single register
